title: Burkina Faso deaf dancers use special technique to follow rhythm
summary: Deaf and hearing impaired people in Burkina Faso are using a special technique to dance. The Vibra-Signe technique helps them feel the rhythm and has opened up new social possibilities for the often marginalised group.
